posts.name: Bitty
posts.tagline: While AI works, work your brain.
posts.description: Tiny brain games for the waits while Claude Code, Cursor or ChatGPT works. A pixel buddy for your desktop, free for Mac, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: Subscription Tool
posts.tagline: Track subscriptions, renewals, and recurring costs
posts.description: Subscription Tool helps you track subscriptions, renewal dates, and monthly spending in one dashboard. Add them manually, see upcoming payments in a calendar, and manage recurring costs without connecting your bank.

posts.name: InvoiceForge by MicroTools Studio
posts.tagline: Fast, privacy-first PDF invoices for freelancers and agents
posts.description: Create clear invoices and prepare professional payment reminders. Simple browser tools for freelancers who want to spend less time chasing payments.

posts.tagline: Calculez vos heures de travail et durées gratuitement
posts.description: Calculatrice Mauricette gratuite : calculez vos heures de travail, pauses déduites, votre feuille de temps hebdomadaire et vos heures supplémentaires.

posts.tagline: Save Money Every Month: The 50/30/20 Rule Explained
posts.description: See how the 50/30/20 rule works with real numbers, plus 14 more practical ways to save money each month.

posts.name: webcopier.tools
posts.tagline: Capture modern websites. Browse them locally.
posts.description: Most website downloaders struggle with modern websites. JavaScript-heavy pages, dynamic content, and complex layouts can turn into incomplete or broken local copies. WebCopier takes a different approach. It uses a real browser to capture websites as they render, then saves them as local, browsable projects on your Windows PC. Built for web developers, designers, and anyone who wants to keep a local reference of a website they can access. Capture websites. Keep them yours.

posts.name: FindMe.Pics
posts.tagline: Pick a poster, print it, let every guest find their photos
posts.description: Choose one of 80 print-ready QR posters, already filled in with your event name and brand. Guests scan it, take a selfie in the browser and get only the photos they're in, at full resolution. No app, no account. Photographers can upload during the event and every face is searchable within seconds. Links are bound to the guest's device, search needs a live selfie, and data auto-deletes. Pay per photo, no subscription. First 100 photos free.

posts.name: LipiVoice Pro
posts.tagline: Private offline AI transcription & subtitles for Windows
posts.description: LipiVoice Pro is a private desktop app for Windows that converts audio and video into text and subtitles (SRT/VTT) 100% offline. Powered by Whisper AI models, it requires no cloud uploads, no monthly subscriptions, and no dedicated GPU.

posts.name: Konvart
posts.tagline: Automate your SEO. Grow on Google and AI.
posts.description: Konvart brings SEO data and SEO execution into one system. It uses SEO data and your business data to determine next steps, including keywords to target, pages to optimize, technical fixes to implement, and backlinks to obtain. Then it starts doing the SEO work based on your controls, including obtaining backlinks, fixing technical issues on your website, creating new content or optimizing existing content based on SERP analysis, and more. Put your SEO on autopilot or copilot with $30/month

posts.name: PinDrop
posts.tagline: Free interactive maps & databases for 7 survival games
posts.description: Free interactive maps, game databases and planners for 7 survival games: Palworld, Enshrouded, 7 Days to Die, Project Zomboid, Kenshi, Sons of the Forest and Bellwright. 24,400+ map markers, every Pal, item and weapon with stats and where to find it, and a breeding planner that plans the path from the Pals you own to the one you want. Built from the games' own data, sources linked. No login, no paywall.

posts.name: Dany's Video
posts.tagline: Browse real VHS sleeves in 3D and play them on a CRT
posts.description: Dany’s Video is a 3D VHS room in your browser. Browse shelves of real scanned tape sleeves, pull one out and turn it over to read the back, then slide it into the VCR and watch it on a CRT, tracking lines and all. Films play from the Internet Archive. Make the room yours: sort your shelves, hang posters, pin film stills to the cork board, open the Gothic cabinet. Built with three.js.

posts.name: GoLetsGo
posts.tagline: A live map of meetups and venue deals near you
posts.description: GoLetsGo is a free map of meetups near you. Browse by category — cafes and bars, walks, board games, cinema, sport, museums — then join someone's plan or create your own in a minute, and chat before you meet. Cafes, bars and studios post their own events, deals and masterclasses, so you can see what's on nearby. Works as an Android app (Google Play) and in any browser, in 7 languages. For adults (18+); not a dating app.

posts.name: PreShipIt
posts.tagline: Is your vibe-coded app safe to ship?
posts.description: PreShipIt answers one question: is your vibe-coded app safe to put online? Paste your URL and an agent probes it like an attacker — then delivers a prioritized, plain-English security report with what to fix first. Built for AI builders shipping fast. $29 one-time per scan; no subscription.

posts.name: PCMonitor v1.3
posts.tagline: Windows monitoring with detachable widgets and floating HUDs
posts.description: PCMonitor v1.3 monitors CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM, disk, battery, network and disk I/O on Windows. The redesigned dashboard adds 3D-style panels, live graphs and two themes. Detach individual widgets, or use resizable, lockable Full HUD and temperature HUD views. Includes top processes, TEMP cleanup and system status. Core monitoring works offline. English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese. Temperature readings depend on sensor support. 7-day trial; one-time purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: Velozity Global Solutions
posts.tagline: Building Better Intelligence
posts.description: Velozity Global Solutions is a Chennai-based AI and software engineering company. We build custom AI products, voice and call-analysis systems, workflow automation and industry software for healthcare, real estate, construction and sales teams, and we install private on-premise AI servers for companies that can't send data to the cloud.

posts.name: PhotoSheet Pro: Print Photos at Home
posts.tagline: Exact-size photo sheets for home printing(A4,10×15,passport)
posts.description: Fit to Page steals millimetres. Your 10×15 comes out wrong. Passport photos get rejected. Ink wasted. PhotoSheet Pro builds exact-size printable sheets for home printers — real mm/inches, not guesswork. • A4, Letter, 4×6 / 10×15 & more • Print-ready PDF @ 300 DPI — print at 100% / Actual Size • Passport Studio (EU, US, CA, CN) with on-device face crop • Photos stay in your browser unless you save a project Try free. No credit card. Upgrade only when you need unlimited exports.

posts.name: LLMGrid
posts.tagline: The Unified LLM Gateway
posts.description: LLMGrid is a unified AI gateway connecting multiple LLM providers through one API. Bring your own keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, and more. Route requests, configure automatic fallbacks, switch models seamlessly, create virtual API keys, and manage access and budgets. Monitor usage, costs, latency, and logs from one dashboard without provider lock-in. **Get started for free and scale as you grow.**

posts.name: Desloppy
posts.tagline: Use AI. Don't sound like it.
posts.description: Desloppy finds the exact lines that make your writing read like AI and shows how to say them like you. Works for emails, LinkedIn posts, decks and cover letters, on the web or inside Claude and ChatGPT. Text is never stored.

posts.name: Valley Run
posts.tagline: New Game for iPhone/iPhone Duo! Fold. Tilt. Survive!
posts.description: Valley Run is a marble game you play by folding or tilting your phone. Built for the iPhone Duo, it turns the hinge into the controller: open and close it to reshape the valley and roll your marble to the finish. Play 70 hand-built courses across 7 worlds, chase Game Center leaderboards for score, speed, and fewest folds, paint your own marble in the Marble Studio, and design your own levels with music that you can send to friends to race.

posts.name: Grok Voice 3.0
posts.tagline: Text to speech and speech to text in one workspace
posts.description: Grok Voice 3.0 turns text into speech and audio into editable text online. Choose a voice, create voiceovers, and download MP3 or WAV. Try it online today.

posts.name: Market Structure Pro
posts.tagline: A trading chart that explains every pattern it finds
posts.description: Market Structure Pro is a trading chart in your browser that explains what it sees: what each pattern is, what it is doing now, and how to trade it. Build your own strategy in minutes with an intuitive no-code builder, backtest it on real history, and let it suggest improvements automatically, each one checked against extra trading costs. Get alerts on screen or by email, even with the chart closed. Try it for 30 minutes with no account, then a free week, then $60 a month.

posts.name: Interfaces for Humans
posts.tagline: Test the interfaces your AI generates, before anyone clicks
posts.description: More AI products now build screens on the fly: a chat answer becomes a form, a table, a booking flow. Nobody reviewed that screen, and it's different every time. RUI tests these generated interfaces both proactive and reactive (evals): it lists every button and form, what each says it does, what it actually does, and where to fix it. Also in the lab: Agentable UI, an open-source agent-native library for people and AI agents. A person sees a table to sort; their agent sees a tool it can call.

posts.name: Webdesly Concierge
posts.tagline: Requests & moments — for hotels, villas, yachts.
posts.description: Your Stay requests for hotels, villas, and yachts — guest portal and staff inbox. Phase 0 demo.

posts.name: SkillTanki
posts.tagline: Classic 2010 tank battles in your browser. No sign-up or P2W
posts.description: SkillTanki recreates the classic 2010 tank arcade that died with Flash — same hulls, bouncy suspension, and ramp physics. Open a link and you're in battle in seconds: no registration, no downloads, no pay-to-win. Supplies are free and unlimited for everyone, so only skill decides. 7 hulls, 9 turrets with distinct mechanics, 101 paints, 91 maps + a map editor. DM, TDM, CTF and Assault — all open from the first second. Offline bots or P2P multiplayer, private rooms, PWA with gamepad support.
